scenario.resolution_expectation: However this conversation goes, it will end with everyone here having settled on some arrangement they are each willing to go along with, even if it is not anyone's first choice. scenario.shared_setting: A busy Singapore hawker centre at lunchtime. Every table in the hawker centre is full and there is no other free seat anywhere. There are no loose chairs and no room to add one without blocking the aisle. A small unopened tissue packet rests beside Jamie. The four people are strangers and have not spoken before.
